annotation.authors_or_issuer: Kure, H.I.; Retnakumari, J.; Nwajana, A.O.; Ismail, U.M.; Romo, B.A.; Egho-Promise, E.
key_provisions_or_claims: CNN with MobileNetV2 transfer learning classifies waste into six categories
Simulated robotic arm uses Euclidean-distance energy cost, about 25-30% energy reduction
Claims alignment with trustworthy AI principles: transparency, robustness, fairness, safety
annotation.summary_en: Conference paper presenting a MobileNetV2 transfer-learning CNN for six-class waste classification coupled with a simulated robotic arm whose sorting paths minimise energy cost. It claims to incorporate trustworthy AI principles (transparency, robustness, fairness, safety), but this is a technical contribution with no governance analysis.
annotation.title_clean: Integrating Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence with Energy-Efficient Robotic Arms for Waste Sorting
annotation.title_en: Integrating Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence with Energy-Efficient Robotic Arms for Waste Sorting
annotation.venue: 13th International Conference on Control, Mechatronics and Automation (ICCMA 2025)
